data.title: 诀 · 休养茶室晨光手捧清茗
data.action: 端坐明窗茶案前双手轻捧青瓷茶盏
data.lighting: 柔和温暖的晨曦斜照窗格与茶烟
data.description: 难得没有外勤通报的早晨，李织烟换下硬挺的黑色战术装，穿一身烟青立领亚麻茶服坐在临窗木案旁。窗外竹影随风轻晃，她指节修长地托起温热的青瓷茶盏，眉梢间那层常年不散的冷意在晨光与茶香里稍稍融化了些许。
data.promptProse: Seated calmly at a sunlit wooden tea table beside a lattice window, Arcane holds a warm porcelain teacup with delicate poise and meets the viewer's gaze with a faint, serene smile.
data.animaCaption: She sits quietly beside the sunlit window holding a steaming porcelain teacup, looking calmly toward the viewer with a faint smile.
